Race Strategy Manager — Privacy Policy
 Last updated: March 2026


1. Information We Collect
 Race Strategy Manager does not collect, store, or share any personally identifiable information.


The app uses the following third-party service that may collect data:


• Google Play Billing — processes in-app purchases (Premium Teams, Season Pass). Purchase records are handled entirely by Google Play. See Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy


2. Data Storage
 Game progress (championship points, race count) and purchase status (unlocked teams, season pass) are stored locally on your device only using Android SharedPreferences. This data is never transmitted off your device.


3. Children's Privacy
 This app does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. The app contains in-app purchases and is intended for general audiences.


4. Changes to This Policy
 We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected with an updated date above.


5. Contact
 If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact the developer through the Google Play Store listing.
